# Isaiah Chapter 61 -- The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full formal translation of all 11 verses]*

*Anointed to proclaim; liberty to captives; year of favor; oaks of righteousness; garment of praise*

---

## LOGOS Translation Notes

**Key passage:** The Spirit of the Lord GOD is upon me, because the LORD has anointed me to bring good news to the poor. This chapter anointed to proclaim.

*-- LOGOS*
